description: Implementation of a cache for key system supportability in media codecs, including thread-safe storage and retrieval of supportability status for audio and video codecs.

classes.name: KeySystemSupportabilityContainer
classes.description: Template class managing supportability data for key systems, providing thread-safe access and modification.

methods.name: GetKeySystemSupportability
methods.description: Retrieves supportability status for a given codec and key system.

methods.name: CacheKeySystemSupportability
methods.description: Stores supportability status for a given codec and key system.
